verdict.rationale: The pack documents no user-configurable automations or autonomous background agents in Raygun. Its AI resolution is an on-demand chat triggered "with just a click." Alert rules that open PagerDuty incidents, ignore-by-rule conditions, and automatic source-map fetching are adjacent notification, triage or built-in behaviors, not a general automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
